description:
As an ordinary office worker, Min Sarin, a woman married to a college classmate who is also an ordinary office worker, is the protagonist, and it shows realistically what kind of hardships an ordinary daughter-in-law goes through in an ordinary in-laws' house.

***Note:** It was serialized on Facebook and Instagram in 2017.  
Since then, the revised version was uploaded simultaneously on KakaoPage and Kakao Webtoon on November 18, 2020, with all 33 episodes.*

**Original Webtoon:**
